scenario.task:
I want to report a TV signal issue in French, but then decide to speak to a human agent instead

User Guide: Start by saying 'Ma télé ne fonctionne pas'. When the agent responds, say 'Je veux parler à un agent' If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
